a: Up to EUR 300,000 over 2 years (own salary, staff, equipment, travel)
e: Independent early-career fellowship to lead your own quantum science project and small team within MCQST, hosted by an MCQST PI, as a step toward grants like the ERC Starting Grant. Eligibility details are on the MCQST site; no citizenship limits stated. Applicants need a PhD and fewer than four years of postdoctoral experience at the deadline.
f: Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology (MCQST)
n: MCQST Munich: Junior Researcher START Fellowship
